dslRule:
<!id: javadochover.add-element-arg>
<!description: Update JavadocHover.addImageAndLabel calls to include the IJavaElement argument. This migrates calls from a removed overloaded method to the version that accepts an IJavaElement, which is required for correct tooltip behavior. >
<!severity: INFO>

org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.text.java.hover.JavadocHover.addImageAndLabel($buf, $imageSrcPath, $imageWidth, $imageHeight, $label, $labelLeft, $labelTop)
=>
org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.text.java.hover.JavadocHover.addImageAndLabel($buf, member, $imageSrcPath, $imageWidth, $imageHeight, $label, $labelLeft, $labelTop)
;;
summary: Update JavadocHover method call to include `IJavaElement` argument, migrating from an older overloaded signature.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
